subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The crack disappeared from the screen, but the lesson stayed.”?
options: Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.
It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.
When people understand the reason, they often behave better.
I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The crack disappeared from the screen, but the lesson stayed. Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When people understand the reason, they often behave better.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The crack disappeared from the screen, but the lesson stayed. Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.」，答案為「Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
